GCAM 7.0 "Survey_NDC_Infl" from Frilingou et al. (2026, Nat. Commun.; Bertram co-author): NDCs with survey-based cost-of-capital trajectories plus an inflation shock. The other nine scenarios of this dataset are the IAM COMPACT Study 6 runs already screened (IDs 1297-1305, values identical, e.g. Survey_NDC = "Study 6: Survey_all"); this inflation variant was added for the journal version and is not in the screening. NDC-level run, main_run FALSE. EU = EU-12 + EU-15 (EU28; flagged). AI-compiled, pending Secretariat verification.
